english: Here is one question programmers don't ask enough. Who will read your code?
Maybe you think my code works and that's enough but no. Just imagine six months from now you forget
how it works or maybe another developer joins your team and has to change it. Now your code is not
just for computers it's for humans. Look at these variables int x or another one is int number of
students. The computer doesn't care both works but which one helps you to understand the program
faster. Exactly you got it. Good code should make the next person's job easier. Use meaningful name
keep function focused. Don't try to write unnecessarily complicated code and don't try to
look clever because there is a dangerous temptation in programming. Writing complicated code just to
prove you are smart. Don't because the best code is often boring it's easy to change easy to test
easy to read and remember computers have to run your code once but developers have to read it
hundreds of times. Tomorrow I'll show you why comments don't automatically make bad code good.
